name: Plenum
author: E. T. Carter
description: A low view down a server aisle: rack rows recede to a hazy vanishing point on the lower left third, their faces dotted with thousands of blinking status lights and drive bays, mirrored in a perforated raised floor under ladder cable trays. Slow bands of warm scanning light sweep away down the aisle through the haze while the room sits in blue-black shade.

params.label: Scan light
params.effect: Brightness of the light bands sweeping down the aisle.

params.label: Haze
params.effect: How thick the haze is, from a clear aisle to racks fading into glow.

params.label: Blink rate
params.effect: How fast the status lights blink, from steady to busy.
